name: scan-to-cutsheets
description: Microsoft Teams Tab App for scanning asset tag barcodes and creating SharePoint cut sheets

scripts.dev:ios: vite --host & sleep 3 && open -a Simulator && sleep 2 && xcrun simctl openurl booted "http://$(ipconfig getifaddr en0):5173"
scripts.dev:android: vite --host & sleep 3 && ~/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator -avd Pixel_3a_API_30_x86 & sleep 15 && ~/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d 'http://10.0.2.2:5173'
